provenance.context: Default offline/expo research-run initialization for Petra's provenance-bound composed flagship. Values initialize run state and do not redefine the biological mechanism parameter set.
provenance.limitation: The seed, model-resource level, founder position, and founder model-biomass are deterministic engineering run-state choices for a reproducible starting view. They are not measured MG1655 culture conditions, physical concentrations, CFU counts, or outcome-forcing values.
